answer: A service can grant influence only after an account locks a refundable bond and completes a gradual trust period. To create many Sybil accounts, an attacker must immobilize separate capital and maintain each identity; audits can forfeit bonds tied to coordinated abuse. This raises the cost but cannot deter a wealthy attacker, and mistaken links may harm honest people, so evidence and appeals are essential. A nebula can hide distant signals, but a juniper marker or cipher alone cannot prove one person per account.
